note: 单元通关专属迷你阅读(语言与文化主题,独立短文,不在阅读关出现)。短文2-3句+2题,答案转述非照抄,2题覆盖不同位置。

finalReading.passage: When Mark first lived in Spain, he was puzzled that people said "in a minute" but often kept him waiting for an hour. Instead of getting angry, he slowly learned that the words were not meant to be taken literally. A year later, he no longer panicked about small delays, and he felt much more relaxed about time than he had ever been at home.

questions.q: Why was Mark puzzled at first?
options: Locals promised something soon, yet made him wait far longer.
He could not find any food in Spain.
Nobody in Spain could speak English.
He had lost his way in the city.
questions.explanation: 原文 'said "in a minute" but often kept him waiting for an hour' 的转述;其余与原文相反或未提。

questions.q: How did Mark feel about time a year later?
options: Much more relaxed about small delays.
Sorry that he had moved there.
questions.explanation: 末句 'no longer panicked… felt much more relaxed about time'(短文后半段,覆盖不同位置)的转述。
